articles.title: How Chinese scientists created an alloy that can survive 2,400 degrees Celsius
articles.summary: Chinese scientists have achieved a groundbreaking advancement by developing an alloy that can withstand temperatures of up to 2,400 degrees Celsius, utilizing tantalum to maintain its strength under extreme conditions, a breakthrough that could revolutionize materials used in aerospace, hypersonic vehicles, and nuclear reactors. This innovation challenges existing limits of metal durability, potentially transforming industries reliant on high-performance materials.

articles.title: What is a supernode, and why does it matter for the China-US tech rivalry?
articles.summary: The emergence of "supernodes," which integrate hundreds or thousands of chips to function as a single supercomputer, marks a pivotal advancement in AI technology, underscoring the intensifying China-US tech rivalry as both nations race to dominate the next generation of artificial intelligence infrastructure. This breakthrough not only enhances computational power but also signifies a strategic shift in how countries approach AI development and deployment.
